description: This file contains unit tests for the 'tools' module of the 'iscc_sdk' package, verifying functions related to installation checks, version info, and download URLs for various tools like ffmpeg, ffprobe, fpcalc, and ipfs.

methods.name: test_install
methods.description: Tests that the 'install' function returns True, indicating successful installation.

methods.name: test_system_tag
methods.description: Checks that the string '64' is present in the output of 'system_tag'.

methods.name: test_is_installed
methods.description: Verifies that 'is_installed' returns True for the 'ffmpeg_bin' path.

methods.name: test_fpcalc_downlod_url
methods.description: Ensures 'fpcalc' is part of the download URL for fpcalc.

methods.name: test_ffprobe_download_url
methods.description: Ensures 'ffprobe' is part of the download URL for ffprobe.

methods.name: test_ffprobe_bin
methods.description: Checks that 'ffprobe' is part of the ffprobe binary path.

methods.name: test_ffmpeg_download_url
methods.description: Ensures 'ffmpeg' is part of the download URL for ffmpeg.

methods.name: test_ffmpeg_bin
methods.description: Checks that 'ffmpeg' is part of the ffmpeg binary path.

methods.name: test_ffprobe_version_info
methods.description: Verifies that the 'FFPROBE_VERSION' string is present in the ffprobe version info.

methods.name: test_ffmpeg_version_info
methods.description: Verifies that the 'FFMPEG_VERSION' string is present in the ffmpeg version info.

methods.name: test_fpcalc_version_info
methods.description: Verifies that the 'FPCALC_VERSION' string is present in the fpcalc version info.

methods.name: test_ipfs_download_url
methods.description: Checks that 'ipfs' is part of the IPFS download URL.

methods.name: test_ipfs_bin
methods.description: Checks that the IPFS binary path exists in the filesystem.

methods.name: test_ipfs_version_info
methods.description: Verifies that 'ipfs version' is part of the IPFS version info string.
